Reprinting already supported whole-event text/subedges or changing labels alone is insufficient. It improves source usability/navigation; it does not close actual random-pool/receipt/entry-script gaps.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Terminology and reward ownership
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: Prefer 正在查阅的资料选项 / 资料列出的后续 / 后续按钮写明 to 本次奖励, 奖励池 or 玩家已到达. A source scene may narrate a completed action, but its page wrapper must remain clearly marked as quoted reference, not current-run state.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Count conflicts
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: count_matches only compares two document counts. True must not imply complete actual pool. Preserve2vs1 and2vs3 prominently; never insert a missing branch, remove the third branch, infer mutual exclusion or sum rewards.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Nine-to-six identity
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: Use community choice_key+subindex and exact target_scene_key. The three同名触碰图案 share ambiguous original candidate sets and cannot be paired by suffix or game_choice_id. Duplicate15盾 and加工品 buttons remain separate occurrences.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Quantity and99 mismatch
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: All quantities belong to future button descriptions, not current random entrance. Preserve precious加工品 wording without manufacturing numeric rarity/all-MOVE pool. 99 gold is a community future-button quantity only: empty game_choice_ids and destination_mismatch remain, surprise_12 only as unresolved technical comparison.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Fresh source failure across all tabs
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: Fail-closed must invalidate or clearly mark stale every card/selected-scene text/technical pane, not merely clear the branch combo. After restoration do not silently reopen a stale scene or previous branch index; require a new explicit reference selection.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Independent window and main-reader context
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: The optional292 selected choice may initialize only the exact manual reference. Main event changes must not reinterpret an old card as belonging to the new event. Either invalidate it as specified or retain it only as a clearly independent titled reference; never overwrite main dossier/map/filter/reading.

necessary_minimum_boundaries.subject: Avoid excess implementation
necessary_minimum_boundaries.rule: One hop only, existing event graph used for identity cross-check; no generic route solver, full recursive reward trajectory, actual pool/evaluator, new offline query, actual transition API or runtime memory mutation.

minimum_acceptance_suggestions: Four exact card identities,9 subedges,6 targets and all6 future buttons bind to full source bytes/attributes, with no same-name normalization.
Explicit quantities20/15/1/99 stay attached to each exact future button; no current-resource total or implied guaranteed reward.
Both conflicting cards have player-visible discrepancy notices; all actual fields remain null.
A valid warm query followed by missing/tampered source clears all active content/navigation, source recovery requires explicit selection, and returned objects are deep copies.
Each of six manual targets opens the exact same-event full source scene; wrong event/branch/target is rejected; root/current run and292 selections remain unchanged.

Actual isolated window checks should prove useful selection/navigation/readability at1050x720 plus same-reference nonzero scroll/selection preservation; do not count old nine-edge existence as a new feature.
progress_limits: 10unparsed and25/57 origin/entry gaps do not reduce, and actual random selection/completion/reward receipt/current-server rules remain open. No probability, expectation, ranking or automatic choice is introduced.
